questions.learningObjective: Apply inflation and purchasing power concepts to realistic financial decisions
questions.stem: Consider this: At an annual return of 12%, about how many years will it take an investment to double in value?

options.misconception: subtracts the rate from seventy-two instead of dividing
multiplies by the rate instead of dividing
uses one hundred instead of the rule's seventy-two

questions.explanation: The rule of seventy-two approximates doubling time as seventy-two divided by the annual rate expressed as a percent. With a 12% return that is about 6 years. Multiplying the numbers or using a different numerator does not give a doubling time.
questions.hint: Divide seventy-two by the percentage rate.
